calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Sep-12-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of Two Minors.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: Cynthia Herbert/Sajja, CSR: Vicki Gross.
Petitioner Rosa Corado appeared in proper as Guardian Ad Litem for the Minor: Angela J. Guar Guardado, was sworn and examined.
Application for an Order Dispensing with Notice, received and filed in court, Order granted in open court.
No objections to the proposed change of name for the two minors were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minor to: Angela J. Shockness.
Decree signed in open court.
